# Open Historia — full agent brief

Open Historia is an open-source AI grand-strategy game. An AI Game Master adjudicates natural-language orders and returns structured changes to the map, diplomacy, events, and timeline.

# Rewrite history, one order at a time

Open Historia is a playable, open-source grand-strategy experiment where an AI Game Master adjudicates diplomacy, conflict, territory, and alternate timelines.

## Start playing

Choose a historical, modern, alternate, or fictional scenario, command a nation in plain English, and watch the map and timeline respond.

## Current product boundary

The natural-language turn loop, campaign memory, local saves, optional cloud saves, and timeline branching are playable. The map and campaign pacing remain prototype-grade, so the project is held rather than presented as a finished strategy game.

## Canonical page

https://historia.aliveville.com/

---

# Start an alternate history

Pick a scenario, nation, difficulty, and AI provider, then issue strategic orders in natural language.

## How play works

The AI Game Master returns structured consequences that update territory, diplomacy, events, and the campaign timeline.

## Account boundary

Guests can play with local saves. Sign-in enables private cloud saves; no save identifier or campaign state is part of public discovery.

## Canonical page

https://historia.aliveville.com/play

---

# Steer history, one order at a time

Open Historia is an open-source AI grand-strategy game built around natural-language command and inspectable turn consequences.

## AI as rules engine

A large language model adjudicates each turn through a strict structured contract rather than fixed combat menus.

## Rewind and branch

Every turn becomes a timeline snapshot, so a player can revisit a prior decision and branch a new alternate history.

## Canonical page

https://historia.aliveville.com/about

---

# Privacy

Guests can play locally. Signed-in identity, cloud saves, and saved provider keys are used only for the requested product functions.

## What is stored

Google OAuth identity and cloud saves are stored only when a player signs in. Saved API keys are encrypted.

## Provider requests and deletion

Turn context goes only to the AI provider selected by the player. Individual cloud saves can be deleted from the product.

## Canonical page

https://historia.aliveville.com/privacy

---

# A free, open-source Pax Historia alternative

Open Historia is an open-source AI grand-strategy experiment playable in the browser: command a nation in plain English, keep long-running campaign memory, and bring your own AI provider or play through the shared free gateway.

## Why players look for alternatives

Pax Historia is a hosted AI sandbox platform where scenario play runs through its own service. Open Historia takes the same idea in an open direction: MIT-licensed code, browser play with local saves, and your choice of AI provider — including a local model — instead of a metered credit system.

## What you get today

Natural-language turns adjudicated by an AI Game Master, 20+ historical and alternate scenarios, a living world map, diplomacy threads, and a rewindable timeline that can branch into alternate histories. Cloud saves are optional and require sign-in.

## Where it is honest about its limits

Open Historia is a held experiment, not a polished platform: the map detail and campaign pacing are prototype-grade, and there is no multiplayer or community scenario marketplace yet.

## Canonical page

https://historia.aliveville.com/pax-historia-alternative

## Discovery boundary

Only the 5 canonical public pages above are indexed. Dynamic play identifiers, save and auth APIs, private gameplay state, and the archived Story Room are excluded.
